title: Eyrie remote-agents registry
description: Approved outbound A2A connections. The model only ever sees the alias (object key); endpoint, auth scheme and credential reference are resolved by the remote_agent tool and never exposed to the model.

name.description: Short display name shown to the model in the available-agents prompt section.

description.description: One-line routing hint. Not an authorization boundary.

agentCardUrl.description: HTTPS URL to the agent's Agent Card (e.g. https://host/.well-known/agent-card.json).

auth.description: See README.md in this folder for the full token-source x header-shape model.

envVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the credential. Never store the credential value itself here.

command.description: Shell command run to obtain the credential; trimmed stdout is used as the token (e.g. 'gh auth token').

cacheSeconds.description: Cache the command's token for this many seconds before re-running it. Omit/0 to run on every call.

header.description: How the resolved token is attached to a request: 'bearer' for Authorization: Bearer, or {type:'api_key', name} for a custom header.

timeoutMs.description: Bounded observation window for request/follow_up before returning current state without cancelling the remote task.
